channel.title: The Local Europe - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local Europe (thelocal.com)

item.title: The best ways to get into Paris from Charles De Gaulle airport
item.description: The RoissyBus shuttle between the French capital and its main airport has now been axed, so here's a look at how to get into Paris from the airport.

item.title: Macron says France to increase nuclear warheads in plan to protect Europe
item.description: President Emmanuel Macron said on Monday that France will increase the number of its nuclear warheads and cooperate with eight countries to help protect the continent as key NATO ally Washington turns away.

item.title: Number of unemployed graduates rise in Sweden as companies want blue-collar workers
item.description: The number of graduates registered with Sweden's Public Employment Service as unemployed is rising, while companies are facing a shortage of blue-collar workers.

item.title: Iran Ambassador to Spain says they can attack any US base in Europe 'if necessary'
item.description: Speaking in Madrid, Iranian Ambassador to Spain Reza Zabib claimed that Iran does not want war but "has the capacity" to react to aggression, even suggesting that any US military base in Europe could be a target.

item.title: Inflation to hit eurozone as war in the Middle East disrupts energy flows
item.description: In the Middle East energy exports to Europe have been disrupted by the conflict between the US, Israel and Iran that has spilled into surrounding regions. Economic experts are predicting a spike in inflation.

item.title: Swedish parliament committee rejects proposal to halt teen deportations
item.description: A Swedish parliament committee on Tuesday as expected rejected a proposal to freeze deportations of young adults.

item.title: More jobs are set to be cut in Switzerland in 2026
item.description: Over 2,000 more employees will lose their jobs, as yet another Swiss company announces a wave of redundancies.

item.title: Where are the US military bases in Spain and why are they there?
item.description: Spain's reluctance to allow the US to launch attacks on Iran from American military bases on Spanish soil has reawakened interest in the purpose of these installations, their location and their history.

item.title: Six in ten foreign doctoral students still in Sweden three years after graduating
item.description: Six out of ten foreign doctoral students stay in Sweden at least three years after graduating, but they struggle to compete with their Swedish peers on the job market.

item.title: Moderate youth leader confident of solution for Sweden's teen deportations
item.description: Douglas Thor, leader of the Moderate Party’s youth wing, raised the issue of unfair deportations long before it became a top political issue. He isn’t seeking credit – he wants a solution for those affected.
